title: Tech Note: Getting Started with 4th Dimension

historical_commentary.text: This introductory overview was designed to bridge the gap between unboxing 4D and reading the manuals — a common need in the era of boxed software. While the specific product lineup and installation procedures are thoroughly outdated, the desire for a high-level product overview before diving into detailed documentation remains a universal onboarding concern.
related_updates: The 4D product lineup has changed dramatically since 1998
Modern 4D is downloaded rather than boxed, with online documentation and tutorials
Many companion products mentioned (4D Insider, 4D Calc, etc.) have been discontinued
